# Kana

> Kana (카나) is an AI agent for Mac that takes everyday chores off your hands: say what you need, and she handles mail, messages, calendar, reminders, notes, files and the web through Claude Code, then reports back in one line. She stops to ask before anything is sent, paid or deleted. Kana is a paid macOS app, shown as a hand-drawn anime character who lives on your desktop. Made by YOOANPAPA, a designer in Korea. Released 2026-11-27.

Category: personal AI agent / AI assistant for Mac / desktop companion for Claude Code users.

Kana is not a desktop pet that only shows status, not a chat window you open, and not a cloud agent that takes over your screen: she stays on the desktop, you hand her a task in a speech bubble, and she reports back in one line. Outward-facing actions wait on an approval card.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Windows version in progress (no date).
- Brain: Kana thinks with Claude Code on this Mac. You need a Claude Pro or Max plan, or an API key. AI usage is not included in Kana's price.
- Price: US$19.00 launch price (regular US$24.00), one-time purchase, no subscription. Up to 3 Macs per license key. All 1.x updates included. 13 outfits.
- No free trial. Full refund within 14 days, no questions asked. Payment by Polar.
- Languages: Korean and English.
- Privacy: Kana has no server of its own; requests go from your Mac straight to your Anthropic account.
- Safety: sending, paying and deleting always stop at an approval card first.

## What Kana can do
- Calendar: see the next two weeks, add (all-day, alerts, repeats), move, edit, delete events
- Reminders and timers (1 minute to 7 days); daily, weekday or weekly routines; watch a page, mail or connected app and alert on a condition
- Apple Mail: read, find unanswered mail, draft, send with attachments, reply / reply all, forward, save attachments
- Messages: send iMessage or SMS with text and files; read received texts (needs Full Disk Access)
- Contacts and Notes: find, add, read, append
- Files: search the whole home folder; copy, move, rename (with undo) in allowed folders; open files (never executables)
- Make spreadsheets, documents, slides, PDFs and images
- Web: search; open, read, click and type in Kana's browser (payments, orders, sending and sign-ups need approval)
- Music: play from your library or a specific Apple Music song (needs Accessibility), pause, next, volume
- Mac: open apps, run your Shortcuts, read and set the clipboard
- Ask by voice: hold Cmd+Shift+1 and speak (Korean or English)
- Up to three tasks at once; checks results after acting

## Measured on the November 28, 2026 release (real Mac)
- Tidy Downloads: "tidy my Downloads" -> 142 files into 13 folders, one approval card, about 5 seconds; "undo" puts them back
- Hotel price comparison: opens Booking.com and Agoda in Kana's browser, 4-5 hotels with on-screen price, source, time checked and an Open link per row, about 30-40 seconds, no approval card; stops at robot checks; booking needs approval
- PDF ready to send: one-page document plus a PDF with embedded fonts, about 20-45 seconds
- Receipt photo to Excel: items, date, store and a =SUM total checked against the receipt, about 15-29 seconds
- Kana's notebook: local file on the Mac (name, hours, brand colors); asks before writing; never overwrites lines you edited
- Heads-up: morning brief at a set time (about 5 seconds) and mail watching while the Mac is awake; quiet when nothing changed
- Loose requests: "dentist next tue afternoon" -> next Tuesday 3 p.m. without asking back; 13 of 15 loose requests finished, 0 false claims
- Simple questions: about 1.5-2.5 seconds


## How Kana compares (honestly)
- vs Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, Claude Duet: they work in the cloud or on their own virtual machine, so they keep working away from your Mac; Kana runs only on your Mac while it is awake and has no phone or messenger access yet. Kana is faster on everyday Mac chores, asks before every send/payment/booking/delete (no "allow always"), keeps its notebook on the Mac, and costs $19 once (plus your Claude plan).
- vs OpenClaw: OpenClaw is free, open source and reachable from 20+ messengers; Kana is a signed Mac app with no setup, no network ports, no third-party skill marketplace and approval on every outward action.

## What Kana won't do
- Send, delete or pay without approval
- Type passwords or card numbers
- Open executables or run shell commands
- Change Focus, Wi-Fi or other settings directly (only via your own Shortcuts)
- Claim something worked when it couldn't check

## Permissions (asked only when first needed)
Calendars, Reminders, Contacts, Notifications, Automation (Mail, Messages, Notes, Music), Screen Recording, Accessibility (playing a song in Music), Full Disk Access (reading texts, confirming delivery)

## FAQ

### What is Kana?
Kana is an AI agent for Mac that takes everyday chores off your hands. She is an anime character on your desktop: hand her a task in a speech bubble and she runs mail, messages, calendar, reminders, file and web errands through Claude Code, then reports back in one line. Before sending, paying or deleting anything, she always stops at an approval card. For macOS (Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later), one-time purchase.

### Is Kana an AI agent?
Yes. She is not a chatbot that only answers; she is an AI agent that gets work done on your Mac. Through Claude Code she handles multi-step errands on her own (drafting replies, checking your calendar, finding files, looking things up on the web) and reports back in one line. Only outward-facing actions (sending, paying, deleting) stop at an approval card for your OK.

### How is Kana different from other AI agents and apps?
KanaDesktop pets for coding agentsChat assistant appsComputer-use AI agents Always on the desktopYesYesA window you openNo, in a window or the cloud Does the errandsMail, calendar, files, webShows status onlyMostly answersYes, by driving the screen Asks before send or payAlways, approval card—VariesVaries PriceOne-time $19–24 + your own AI usageMostly freeSubscriptionUsually a subscription

### What can Kana do?
Calendar (see, add, move, edit, delete), Reminders, timers like “remind me in 10 minutes”, daily, weekday or weekly routines, and watching a web page or your mail to alert you only when a condition is met. In Apple Mail she reads, finds mail you haven’t answered, replies, forwards and saves attachments. She sends iMessage or SMS and reads texts you received. She also handles Contacts and Notes, finds and opens files anywhere in your home folder, makes spreadsheets, documents, slides, PDFs and images, and searches the web or books and orders in her own browser (after you approve). She can play and pause music, set the volume, open apps, run your Shortcuts and use the clipboard. You can also hold ⌘⇧1 and just say it. She works on up to three tasks at once; a fourth waits its turn.

### What won’t Kana do?
She never sends, deletes or pays without your approval. She never types passwords or card numbers. She never opens executables or runs shell commands. She doesn’t change Focus, Wi-Fi or other Mac settings directly, only through a Shortcut you made. She never claims something worked when she couldn’t check.

### Which Mac permissions does Kana need?
Kana asks only the first time a task needs it, and an “Open Settings” button takes you to the right pane. Calendars, Reminders, Contacts and Notifications. Automation: Mail, Messages, Notes and Music. Screen Recording: when you point at your screen. Accessibility: to start a song from Apple Music. Full Disk Access: to read received texts or confirm a message went.

### Do I pay for the AI separately?
Yes. AI isn't included in Kana's price. Kana thinks with Claude Code on this Mac: with a Claude Pro or Max plan it runs within your plan, and with an API key usage is billed to your Anthropic account.

### Is there a free trial?
No. Instead, you can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked. Refund policy

### How do I install it?
After checkout, download Kana-2026.11.27.dmg, open it, and drag Kana into your Applications folder. Enter your license key the first time you open it.

### How many Macs can I use it on?
Three per key. When you change Macs, use “Remove key from this Mac” in Kana's settings to free the seat.

### Where do my mail and files go?
Kana has no server of ours. Your request and the pieces it needs go straight from your Mac to your own Anthropic account. We cannot see them. Privacy policy

### What about updates?
Every 1.x version is included at no extra cost.

### Does it run on Windows or Intel Macs?
For now it runs on Apple silicon Macs (M1 or newer). A Windows version is on the way. We'll let you know when it's ready.

### Can I use my Mac license on Windows?
A Windows version is on the way. We'll let you know when it's ready.

### Does Kana speak English?
Yes. She speaks Korean and English.

### Is Kana always right?
Kana runs on AI (Claude), so she can be wrong. She calculates with code and cites her sources, but please double-check important numbers and facts.
